name: Group 3 - AI - Weekly Newsletter Generator (Resilient v2)

parameters.content:
### Weekly Newsletter Generator — Resilient v2

Every **Friday 14:00 (Nairobi time)**, this workflow builds the "Nairobi Nexus" tech/business newsletter draft end-to-end and emails it for approval.

**Flow:**
1. Trigger fires
2. Fetch + AI-summarize 5 KE news sources in parallel
3. Validate results → Chief Editor (GPT-4o) drafts the intro; Backup Editor (GPT-4o-mini) covers if it fails
4. Render to HTML → log to Sheets → email draft for approval

## 1. Trigger

Runs every Friday at 14:00, just kicks off all 5 source fetches at once.

##  2. Fetch & Summarize Sources

Five parallel lanes TechCabal, Business Daily, The Star, Standard, Kenyan WallStreet. Each: HTTP nodes fetches news → If node checks the data fetched  is not empty before sending to the AI Agent summarizers.

## 3. Validate, Compile Draft & Fail-safe

Combines all 5 outcomes, bails out safely if every source failed, and otherwise has the Chief Editor (GPT-4o) write the newsletter intro with a Backup Editor (GPT-4o-mini) on standby.

## 4. Format, Log & Deliver

Strips stray code fences, renders Markdown to  HTML, appends a row to the Drafts sheet for audit history, then emails the HTML draft to team for approval.

Every lane: **HTTP Request → IF (`data` not empty)**.
- If Data is  not-empty → AI Agent extracts headlines for all. All 5 AI agents share one OpenRouter chat model.
- If data is empty or error occurs a Code node is set to return error that a human can understand.

### Merge & Collate

Merge is in **Append** mode with each source hard-wired to its own input . 

Collate then re-parses every item defensively catching bad JSON and stripping stray markdown code-fence markers before splitting sources into succeeded/failed.

### Primary/backup editor failover

Chief Editor (GPT-4o) is set to **On Error → Continue Using Error Output**, with 2 retries 2s apart first. If it still fails, execution routes to the Backup Editor (GPT-4o-mini) for a simpler intro: so one flaky model call never blocks the send.

### Email Alert: In the event of total failure

If **zero** of the 5 sources produced a usable summary, the workflow skips the editor entirely and emails "Newsletter Generation FAILED" straight to the team, listing which sources failed. Otherwise it proceeds with whatever did succeed  even just 1 of 5.

### Audit trail fields

Every draft gets stamped with run date/timestamp, which sources succeeded/failed, which model actually wrote it (primary vs. backup) all logged to Google Sheets.
